name: qr-code-builder
description: This repository contains the source code of the website for generating free, customizable QR codes

paragraphs: A free, fully customizable QR code builder built with React, TypeScript and Vite. Pick one of 20 content types, style the code, and export it as PNG, SVG or PDF. Everything runs in the browser: no account, no backend, your data never leaves the page.
features: 20 content templates with spec-compliant payloads and proper escaping: URL, Wi-Fi, calendar event, geo location, vCard, email, SMS, phone call, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube,…
Inline validation on every form, with international phone input (country selector).
Styling - 6 dot styles, independent corner styles, solid or linear/radial gradient, transparent or colored background, 6 built-in color presets, and your own presets with JSON import/export.
Center logo (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG) with size and margin controls; error correction levels L/M/Q/H.
Export - PNG and SVG at 512, 1024 or 2048 px, PDF at 5 cm, 10 cm or A4-fit print size (300 DPI), copy to clipboard; blocked with a message when the content exceeds the QR capacity.
